problem_common.name: Common Problem Checks
problem_common.description: Check Japanese remnants, punctuation, line breaks, and dictionary usage.

avgSentenceLengthThreshold.label: Long-sentence threshold
avgSentenceLengthThreshold.description: Flag long sentences when the average segment length exceeds this value. Suggested range: 15–25. Requires the long-sentence check.

file_epub_epub.name: Epub files
file_epub_epub.description: Translates Epub files, with support for automatic name detection, bilingual display, reduced font size, and file splitting so a single file can be translated by several threads. Parts of the code and the regular expressions come from Ainiee.

autoDetectNames.label: Detect names automatically
autoDetectNames.description: Extracts the speaker and the body text from a paragraph with a regular expression.

namePattern.label: Name detection rule
namePattern.description: The regular expression must contain the two named groups name and message, which match the name and the body text respectively.

nameTemplate.label: Name and text join format
nameTemplate.description: Joins the detected name and the translation again; {name} stands for the name and {message} for the body text.

bilingual.label: Bilingual display
bilingual.description: Shows the translation and the source text together in the output ebook.

sourceColor.label: Source text color
sourceColor.description: The CSS color of the source text in bilingual mode, e.g. #808080 for gray.

sourceScale.label: Source text size ratio
sourceScale.description: The source text size relative to the normal size in bilingual mode; 0.8 means 80%.

splitChapters.label: Split chapters and translate them in parallel
splitChapters.description: Splits the EPUB into chapters so they can be processed concurrently, and merges them back into an ebook when done.

file_galtransl_json.name: GalTransl standard json
file_galtransl_json.description: The standard name (optional)-message json format; including a name gives better results

output_with_src.label: Keep the source text in the output
output_with_src.description: Keeps the source text in the output JSON so it can be compared with the translation.

file_i18n_json.name: Key-value json files
file_i18n_json.description: Handles json files in any dictionary format. It can be used for i18n translation or for translating the output of mtool (but text extracted by such tools has no names, so VNT or SE is recommended for galgames)

file_msgtool_script.name: Galgame script files
file_msgtool_script.description: Reads and writes galgame script files directly through res/msg_tool.exe (lifegpc/msg-tool). The json output of msg-tool is already in GalTransl's [{"name"?, "message"}] format, so no intermediate conversion is needed. Supports kirikiri, BGI/Ethornell, Yu-Ris, Artemis, CatSystem2, Circus, Musica, QLIE, Softpal, WillPlus/AdvHD, ExHibit, Favorite, Escu:de, Entis GLS and other engines. SExtractor-compatible JIS substitution can be enabled, and uif_config.json is generated in the output directory.

msg_tool_path.label: Tool path
msg_tool_path.description: Leave it empty to use the bundled msg_tool.exe. Fill in an executable path only when you need a different version of the tool.

script_type.label: Script engine
script_type.description: Auto-detect is usually the right choice. For BGI files without an extension you can pick BGI / Ethornell; a manual choice applies to every script this plugin handles.

options.bgi: BGI / Ethornell (including scripts without an extension)
options.artemis_panmimisoft_txt: Artemis ぱんみみそふと TXT

source_encoding.label: Source encoding
source_encoding.description: The encoding used to read the source scripts; the write-back encoding is not changed. KAG scripts are detected automatically by default and other engines use the tool default; only set it when garbled text appears.

patched_encoding.label: Output encoding
patched_encoding.description: Leave it empty to use the engine’s default write-back encoding, which does not follow the source encoding. CP932 cannot represent some Chinese characters; enable JIS substitution when the game needs Japanese encoding, or choose GB2312 or UTF-8 when other encodings are supported. The encoding is checked before writing back, and failures report the character and how it was handled. This setting has no effect while JIS substitution is enabled.

jis_substitution.label: JIS substitution
jis_substitution.description: Uses the SExtractor dictionary to replace Chinese characters that CP932 cannot represent with Japanese ones, writes back as CP932, and generates uif_config.json in the output root. UIF or a matching substitution font is needed to restore the display.

jis_unmapped.label: Handling of JIS unmapped characters
jis_unmapped.description: Only takes effect while JIS substitution is enabled. Writing is blocked by default; choosing a full-width space matches the SExtractor behaviour and records the lost characters in remain in uif_config.json.

options.error: Report the error and stop writing (recommended)
options.space: Replace with a full-width space and record it

extra_args.label: Extra tool arguments
extra_args.description: Command line arguments passed to msg-tool, one argument or argument value per line. Filling this in bypasses reading the cache.

keep_bilingual.label: Keep the source text
keep_bilingual.description: Appends the source text after the translation when writing back. Games may have limits on length and layout, so check the in-game display after enabling it.

bilingual_sep.label: Bilingual separator
bilingual_sep.description: The separator between the translation and the source text; only takes effect when the source text is kept. A single line break by default.

timeout.label: Processing timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: The longest wait for one file calling the tool; a timeout stops that run. Large scripts may need a larger value.

read_cache.label: Enable the read cache
read_cache.description: Reuses the extracted text to speed up browsing and repeated reads. The text is extracted again automatically after the source files, the configuration or the tool change.

file_mtbench_aio.name: Machine translation quality evaluation
file_mtbench_aio.description: Used to evaluate machine translation quality. The input file is a name (optional)-message json file with an additional ref field, where ref holds the reference translation.

task.label: Evaluation metric
task.description: Choose how the translation quality is evaluated; COMET has to load a model, and the cutoff rate checks whether the translation is truncated.

chrf_ngram.label: chrF maximum n-gram
chrf_ngram.description: The maximum character n-gram length used by chrF; only takes effect in chrF mode.

chrf_beta.label: chrF recall weight
chrf_beta.description: The relative weight of recall in chrF; the larger the value, the more recall matters.

comet_model_name.label: COMET model
comet_model_name.description: The model name or path used by COMET; only takes effect in COMET mode.

comet_batch_size.label: COMET batch size
comet_batch_size.description: How many entries are evaluated per batch; a larger value may use more GPU memory.

file_plaintext_txt.name: TXT/Markdown text file reader
file_plaintext_txt.description: Handles .txt, .md and .markdown text files directly and translates them line by line. Markdown is treated as plain text, so Markdown syntax, indentation and code blocks are not protected; it should not be used for scripts that contain many control codes.

bilingual.label: Save bilingual text
bilingual.description: Keeps the translation and the source text together in the output text.

bilingualLayout.label: Bilingual layout
bilingualLayout.description: How the source text and the translation are arranged in bilingual output.

sourceEncoding.label: Source encoding
sourceEncoding.description: The character encoding used to read TXT/Markdown files. Check the source file encoding when the text is garbled or cannot be read.

outputEncoding.label: Output encoding
outputEncoding.description: The character encoding used to save TXT/Markdown files, UTF-8 by default.

file_subtitle_srt_lrc_vtt.name: srt, lrc, vtt subtitle file reader
file_subtitle_srt_lrc_vtt.description: Handles .srt, .lrc and .vtt subtitle files directly and translates them.

bilingual.label: Save bilingual subtitles
bilingual.description: Keeps the source text and the translation in the same subtitle entry.

bilingualLayout.label: Bilingual layout
bilingualLayout.description: How the source text and the translation are arranged in bilingual subtitles.

file_translator___xlsx.name: Translator++ xlsx files
file_translator___xlsx.description: xlsx files exported by Translator++; the result is written back to the Machine translation sheet.

autoDetectNames.label: Detect names automatically
autoDetectNames.description: Separates the speaker and the body text with the given rules.

namePattern.label: Name detection rule
namePattern.description: The regular expression must contain the two named groups name and message.

nameTemplate.label: Name and text join format
nameTemplate.description: Joins the name and the translation again using {name} and {message}.

removeLineBreaks.label: Remove line breaks
removeLineBreaks.description: Removes the line breaks in the text when writing to the Translator++ sheet.

text_bgi_fixruby.name: BGI ruby tag fixer
text_bgi_fixruby.description: Supports removing incorrect ruby tags and automatically correcting the number of emphasis marks (・)

remove_incorrect.label: Remove incorrect ruby tags
remove_incorrect.description: Cleans up BGI ruby tags in the translation that are incomplete, unpaired or empty.

auto_correct.label: Correct the number of emphasis marks
auto_correct.description: Corrects the emphasis marks (・ or …) at the ruby position to the same number of dots as the body text length.

process_log_level.label: Fix log level
process_log_level.description: The log level used for each modified text; debug is usually kept, and info can be used while investigating a problem.

text_common_full2Half.name: General - full-width and half-width conversion
text_common_full2Half.description: Supports converting between full-width characters (digits, upper and lower case letters, punctuation) and half-width characters. The replacement table and the moment of the replacement can be customized.

replacePunctuation.label: Convert punctuation too
replacePunctuation.description: Besides digits and English letters, also converts the punctuation in the default replacement table.

stage.label: Execution stage
stage.description: Choose whether the source text or the translation is processed, and whether it runs before or after the matching text processing step.

reverse.label: Half-width to full-width
reverse.description: When off, full-width characters are converted to half-width; when on, the conversion goes the other way.

replacements.label: Custom character replacement table
replacements.description: Enter a JSON object, for example {"Ａ":"A"}. Always write it as “full-width character: half-width character”; the direction is swapped automatically for the reverse conversion.

text_common_lineBreakFix.name: In-line line break fixer
text_common_lineBreakFix.description: Compares the text before and after translation and adds to or removes line breaks in the translated text until both have the same number.

lineBreak.label: Script line break marker
lineBreak.description: Enter the line break marker the script uses, such as [r]; an actual line break can be entered too. The default is the Windows line break (CRLF).

mode.label: Line break mode
mode.description: Keep position breaks lines at the relative position of the source text; even splits the text evenly; split longest splits the longest segment over and over; front and back group the breaks at the beginning or the end; fixed length breaks lines at a threshold.

segmentLength.label: Characters per segment
segmentLength.description: Only takes effect in fixed length mode; the line break marker is inserted once this many characters are reached.

force.label: Force re-layout
force.description: Processes the text with the selected mode even when the translation and the source text have the same number of line breaks.

segmenter.label: Chinese segmenter
segmenter.description: Used to avoid breaking lines in the middle of a word where possible. BudouX is the lightest; the other options need extra dependencies, and HanLP may also download a fairly large model.

text_common_normalfix.name: General - regular text fixes
text_common_normalfix.description: General text fixes: 1. fix duplicated leading or trailing punctuation; 2. fix cases where \r\n line breaks were turned into \n.

text_common_skipNoJP.name: Skip lines without Japanese
text_common_skipNoJP.description: Skips lines that contain no Japanese

text_example_nouse.name: Example text plugin
text_example_nouse.description: This is an example text plugin; no project should use it

set_int.label: Integer setting example
set_int.description: Demonstrates how a plugin receives an integer value; this example plugin should not be enabled in a real translation project.

set_string.label: Text setting example
set_string.description: Demonstrates how a plugin receives a string value; it does not affect any real translation feature.

set_bool.label: Boolean switch example
set_bool.description: Demonstrates the switch control for an English configuration key.

chineseKeyExample.label: Chinese configuration key example
chineseKeyExample.description: Demonstrates a switch control that uses a Chinese configuration key.

text_message_serverchan_tgbot.name: Completion notification
text_message_serverchan_tgbot.description: After the translation finishes, pushes a completion message to ServerChan / Telegram Bot and supports a sound notification

channel.label: Completion notification channel
channel.description: Choose the channels that receive a notification when the translation finishes; several can be selected. Clearing every channel disables network notifications.

Telegram_Bot_API_URL.label: Telegram API address
Telegram_Bot_API_URL.description: The official Telegram API is used by default; only change it for a self-hosted endpoint or a proxy service.

Telegram_Bot_Token.label: Telegram bot token
Telegram_Bot_Token.description: The bot token given by BotFather; only used when Telegram notifications are enabled.

Telegram_Bot_ChatID.label: Telegram target chat ID
Telegram_Bot_ChatID.description: The user or group chat ID that receives the notification; the bot needs permission to send messages to that chat.

ServerChan_SendKey.label: Server酱 SendKey
ServerChan_SendKey.description: The SendKey from the Server酱 account; only used when Server酱 notifications are enabled.

soundEnabled.label: Play a completion sound
soundEnabled.description: Plays a success or failure sound when the translation ends.

customAudio.label: Use a custom sound
customAudio.description: When on, the audio file specified below is used; sound notifications must be enabled as well.

successAudio.label: Success sound path
successAudio.description: The audio file played on success; only takes effect when a custom sound is enabled.

failureAudio.label: Failure sound path
failureAudio.description: The audio file played on failure; only takes effect when a custom sound is enabled.

openaiTts.label: Read out loud with speech synthesis
openaiTts.description: Generates the announcement through an OpenAI-compatible speech synthesis API; sound notifications and an API key must be configured, and this may cost money.

OpenAI_API_Key.label: Speech synthesis API key
OpenAI_API_Key.description: The API key of the speech synthesis service; only used when speech synthesis is enabled.

OpenAI_API_Base_URL.label: Speech synthesis API address
OpenAI_API_Base_URL.description: The base address of the OpenAI-compatible service, usually ending with /v1.

OpenAI_TTS_Voice.label: Announcement voice
OpenAI_TTS_Voice.description: Choose the speech synthesis voice; the voices actually available depend on the service in use.
